L0_raw.description: RPC API milestone badges + MHTML learnings badge page with codelab links (up to 1000 most recent)

L1_normalized.description: Two independent streams: public_badges (milestone badges from RPC, 171) and micro_learnings (codelab activities from MHTML, 805). Unavailable codelab links marked as retired.

L2_published.description: Archive complete combines both streams; index splits them; JSON-LD combines.

L3_display.description: Display both counts separately in README/llms.txt and index header.
